title: From Sentences to Evidence: How Sentence-Level Instruction Is Transforming Writing in My Classroom
author: Solin
summary: Solin demonstrates how teaching sentence-level writing skills first—kernel sentences, because/but/so structures, appositives—creates a foundation for strong paragraph and essay writing. Students build confidence when writing becomes a learnable set of discrete moves rather than a mysterious skill.
points: Explicit sentence-level instruction precedes paragraph mastery
Because/but/so conjunctions teach logical thinking within sentences
Appositives embed knowledge precisely without separate sentences
Retrieval practice daily normalizes writing and strengthens both content and expression
Knowledge of content is prerequisite for strong writing
quotes: Strong writing isn't about using fancy vocabulary. It's about explaining ideas clearly and precisely.

When students master the building blocks of writing at the sentence level, something powerful happens. Strong writing stops being accidental. It becomes inevitable.” Archived from Substack on yes by Tim.
